newsitem.title: USA: National Data, EDS enter alliance.
newsitem.headline: National Data, EDS enter alliance.

text.p: National Data Corp and Electronic Data Systems Corp (EDS) said on Monday that the companies entered an alliance in the payment systems business, including National Data's purchase of EDS's domestic multi-client bank card processing unit.
The companies said in a joint statement that they will enter a marketing arrangement in the payment systems business, and EDS's continuation of providing computer resources for customers.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.

National Data and EDS said the business acquired by NDC consists of EDS' merchant and card issuing customer base of several hundred banks, savings and loan institutions and credit unions currently supported in a service bureau environment. It will be operated by Global Payment Systems, a limited liability company of National Data and MasterCard International Inc.
As part of the joint marketing arrangement, EDS will exclusively market Global Payment's systems and services.
